live_alert_urgency.description: Open with an urgent 'this is happening now' alert, show a 3D character rushing, and resolve it with the free tool and a calm 'save this'.

disguise_reveal_then_objection.description: Start with a mundane-looking file or situation, reveal the hidden problem or power underneath, then have the narrator answer each worried 'but what if' in turn, ending with a verdict line.
disguise_reveal_then_objection.hook_pattern: This [ordinary-looking thing] hides [something valuable] and nobody can get in

proof_shots_showcase.description: Open by promising what the tool can do, then have the narrator walk through two or three before/after result panels (file size drops, a clean output) while the low-poly character reacts to each one.
proof_shots_showcase.hook_pattern: Watch what [product] can capture, then the proof shots roll

hot_take_problem_callout.description: Have the narrator name one annoying, familiar form problem as a mini complaint, show the error panel on screen, then let the character fix it in one step.
hot_take_problem_callout.hook_pattern: [Famous thing] needs fixing, here is the problem

choices_change_stats.description: Show a stats panel (file size, quality, pages) and have the narrator explain how each small choice by the character changes the numbers, with cause and effect in two steps.
choices_change_stats.hook_pattern: What you do here changes everything, look at the stats

aspirant_pride_moment.description: Tell a tiny emotional story of an aspirant who is close to their dream and is stopped by a small file problem, then solved by the tool, with the narrator keeping a warm, steady tone.

struggle_to_win_story.description: Narrate a short two-struggle story where the character is under pressure from a deadline and a problem, and the tool is the quiet turning point that lets them submit the form.
struggle_to_win_story.hook_pattern: While [hardship A] was happening, [person] was fighting [hardship B]

numbered_free_tools_showcase.description: Narrate a tiny story where one character meets N small problems in a row. Each problem gets one of our tools as the fix, shown in a panel with a number badge and a clear before/after result.
numbered_free_tools_showcase.hook_pattern: If you use [device/thing], these N free [tools] will make your life easier

instant_demo_cold_open.description: Start the story at the moment of success, where a character's file works instantly. Then rewind to show the problem and the tool that fixed it, with the result panel on screen.
instant_demo_cold_open.hook_pattern: Watch this: [instant demo], then N free tools to make your life easier

two_jobs_one_tool_explainer.description: Open on a chore the narrator hates, then have the 3D character use one tool to do two jobs in one go. Show a time or size payoff on a panel, then reveal one bonus use near the end.
two_jobs_one_tool_explainer.hook_pattern: If you hate [chore], you need this [thing that does two jobs in one]
